description: This file manages background synchronization tasks for the Notesnook mobile app, including configuring background fetch, handling background tasks, and initializing sync processes on app boot or background events.

methods.name: doInBackground
methods.description: Executes a callback in the background, handling platform-specific background task initiation and completion.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Configures and starts the background fetch process if not already started and if background sync is enabled.

methods.name: task
methods.description: Handles individual background fetch events, performing background sync and signaling task completion.

methods.name: onBackgroundSyncStarted
methods.description: Performs the actual background synchronization tasks, including database sync, notifications, and UI updates.

methods.name: onBoot
methods.description: Initializes background sync tasks on app boot, setting up notifications and updating notes.

methods.name: registerHeadlessTask
methods.description: Registers the background sync task to run in headless mode when the app is not active.
